title: Additional ASMP Resources
description: Additional ASMP Resources by Wrathic. Includes, but not limited to, collectibles, hats, and trophies!
body: This pack is intended to be used on the ASMP server and with the Resclone mod to auto-update so I may add custom item models as the server progresses and history is made. I plan to add custom item models for events and shops, including but not limited to, hats, collectibles, and trophies.
